proofBoundary: Instruction evaluation rubric; not executed model behavior or native/provider acceptance. Deterministic source/adapter tests are separate.

scenarios.situation: Verified owner has a relevant injected dated clue and asks for current detail.
must: resolve the relevant native task and retrieve needed detail
mustNot: treat a snapshot as the answer

scenarios.situation: Owner asks about a topic absent from the briefing, or last checkpoint is days old.
must: use supported bounded native metadata discovery then one relevant task read when unambiguous
disambiguate or report narrow unavailable capability

scenarios.situation: Known-disabled, child, trivial or unchanged work reaches Stop.
must: allow normal Stop unless independent work/return obligation requires continuation

scenarios.situation: Eligible root reaches meaningful changed checkpoint; setting/revision not already current.
must: use mutation receipt without extra read
preserve exact revision and conflict fences
mustNot: claim a disabled or conflicted write succeeded

scenarios.situation: Optional awareness is skipped but real unfinished work or committed owner return remains.
must: retain exact authority and plan revision
mustNot: treat awareness completion or omission as task completion
